facts.text: AKO Helm installation means one of two things: - An operator release (`mongodb/mongodb-atlas-operator`) that by default brings its CRDs along as a subchart. - An operator release plus a separate CRD release (`mongodb/mongodb-atlas-operator-crds`).

**In scope:** how the `mongodb/mongodb-atlas-operator` Helm chart installs the Atlas Kubernetes Operator. That covers the chart's parts (the CRD subchart, Deployment, RBAC, ServiceAccount, and global secret templates), how values become operator flags and environment variables, the invariants the templates enforce, and the limits of Helm's lifecycle for CRDs.
